author: toketrain
body: There should be beacons under monuments on DTM. That way when the monument is destroyed, you can tell which one is broken easily. Unless people like having to run around each monument or looking at the scoreboard and figuring it out. (Would be protected so you can't get the pyramid minerals)
body_tagged: There should be beacons under monuments on DTM. That way when the monument is destroyed, you can tell which one is broken easily. Unless people like having to run around each monument or looking at the scoreboard and figuring it out. (Would be protected so you can't get the pyramid minerals)
title: Nebula Beacons
